source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: As wildfires get worse, some states are struggling to pass fire protection rules
articles.summary: 美国西部野火愈演愈烈，但要求房主做防火改造的法规在多地受阻；专家呼吁社区以政治意愿推动建筑规范，降低火灾风险。

sentences.en: Three wildfires in Spokane, Wash., including the Old Trails Fire, destroyed more than 800 homes and buildings.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州斯波坎的三场野火（含“老路之火”）摧毁了 800 多栋房屋和建筑。

sentences.en: For years, Washington has debated adopting statewide rules to help protect communities during wildfires.
sentences.zh: 多年来，华盛顿州一直在讨论是否采用全州性的法规，以在野火灾害中保护社区。

sentences.en: When two different wildfires threatened Dave Kokot’s house earlier this month, he and his family packed up keepsakes as they prepared to leave.
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，两场不同的野火威胁到戴夫·科科特的房子，他和家人收拾好珍藏品，准备撤离。

sentences.en: The siding on Kokot’s house is made of fire-resistant materials, instead of wood.
sentences.zh: 科科特房子的外墙采用的是防火材料，而不是木头。

sentences.en: Research shows those precautions help houses resist the onslaught of tiny, burning embers carried by the wind.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，这些预防措施能帮助房屋抵御随风飘散的微小燃烧余烬的袭击。

sentences.en: Recently, he’s been pushing Washington state regulators to make those preparations mandatory for residents in areas at high risk of burning.
sentences.zh: 最近，他一直在敦促华盛顿州监管机构，让高火灾风险地区的居民必须采取这些防范措施。

sentences.en: Washington has been developing new wildfire safety regulations for several years, including building codes for homes constructed in risky areas.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州几年来一直在制定新的野火安全法规，包括为建在危险区域的房屋设定建筑规范。

sentences.en: After public pushback, state legislators backtracked and repealed some of the requirements.
sentences.zh: 在公众的反对之后，州议员退缩了，并废除了其中的一些要求。

sentences.en: Other Western states have also struggled to pass wildfire regulations affecting homeowners’ properties.
sentences.zh: 其他西部州在通过影响房主财产的野火法规方面也同样步履维艰。

sentences.en: In Spokane, dry conditions and extreme weather set the stage for the explosive wildfires in August.
sentences.zh: 在斯波坎，干燥的条件和极端天气为八月的猛烈野火埋下了伏笔。

sentences.en: Homeowners would also be required to manage flammable vegetation to create defensible space.
sentences.zh: 房主还将被要求清理易燃植被，以营造可防御的空间。

grammar: 现在完成时（has debated）："Washington has debated adopting statewide rules" 用现在完成时表示动作从过去持续到现在，强调长期讨论。
时间状语从句（When...）："When two different wildfires threatened Dave Kokot’s house" 用 when 引导时间状语从句，主句用一般过去时叙述过去事件。
介词短语 instead of："materials, instead of wood" 中 instead of 表示“而不是”，引出对比对象。
现在完成进行时（has been developing）："Washington has been developing new wildfire safety regulations" 强调从过去持续到现在且仍在进行。
一般过去时并列："state legislators backtracked and repealed some of the requirements" 用 and 连接两个过去动作。
现在完成时（have struggled）："Other Western states have also struggled to pass..." 表示过去到现在一直存在的困难状态。
动词不定式作目的状语："to manage flammable vegetation to create defensible space" 中两个 to do 分别表目的。

articles.title: A pizza-sized ocean predator and a tribe are trying to protect each other
articles.summary: 向日葵海星因一场“海洋大瘟疫”几近灭绝，华盛顿大学与萨米什部落联手人工繁育并放归，试图让这一关键物种重归太平洋。

sentences.en: Sunflower stars are one of the Pacific Ocean’s most endangered sea creatures.
sentences.zh: 向日葵海星是太平洋中最濒危的海洋生物之一。

sentences.en: For the past year, University of Washington researchers have worked closely with the Samish Indian Nation to bring this 24-armed creature back from the brink of extinction.
sentences.zh: 过去一年里，华盛顿大学的研究人员与萨米什印第安民族密切合作，试图让这种有 24 条腕足的生物免于灭绝。

sentences.en: A vast underwater pandemic nearly wiped it out.
sentences.zh: 一场大规模的水下瘟疫几乎将它消灭殆尽。

sentences.en: A team of divers crammed into the cabin as the small craft bounced and slammed across Rosario Strait.
sentences.zh: 当小船在罗萨里奥海峡上颠簸穿行时，一组潜水员挤在船舱里。

sentences.en: They were on their way to pick up precious cargo: 20 endangered sunflower stars, raised by hand in a lab.
sentences.zh: 他们正前往取走珍贵的“货物”：20 只濒危的向日葵海星，是在实验室里人工养育的。

sentences.en: The stars were supposed to be turned loose last October.
sentences.zh: 这些海星原本应该在去年十月被放归大海。

sentences.en: Then divers found the deadly sea-star wasting disease surging throughout the San Juans.
sentences.zh: 后来潜水员发现致命的“海星萎缩病”在圣胡安群岛肆虐。

sentences.en: Sunflower stars can grow more than 3 feet wide and are the fastest of all sea stars.
sentences.zh: 向日葵海星可以长到超过 3 英尺宽，是所有海星中速度最快的。

sentences.en: They’re considered a keystone species, whose presence or absence can reshape a whole ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 它们被视为关键物种，它们的存在与否能够重塑整个生态系统。

sentences.en: But the speedy predators have been unable to outrun a wasting disease that’s killed billions of sea stars.
sentences.zh: 但这些敏捷的捕食者却没能跑赢那种已经杀死数十亿只海星的萎缩病。

sentences.en: It took researchers a decade to pinpoint the Vibrio bacteria behind the disease.
sentences.zh: 研究人员花了十年时间才查明导致这种疾病的弧菌属细菌。

vocab.zh: 关键的（keystone species 关键物种）
边缘（brink of extinction 灭绝边缘）

grammar: 现在完成时（have worked）："researchers have worked closely with..." 强调从过去持续到现在并可能继续的合作。
动词不定式作目的："to bring this creature back from the brink of extinction" 中 to do 表目的。
一般过去时："A vast underwater pandemic nearly wiped it out" 叙述已发生的事实。
过去分词作后置定语："raised by hand in a lab" 过去分词短语修饰 stars，表被动。
最高级 + of 短语："the fastest of all sea stars" 用最高级加 of 表示比较范围。
关系代词 whose 引导定语从句："a keystone species, whose presence or absence can reshape..." whose 在从句中作定语。
现在完成时（have been unable）："the speedy predators have been unable to outrun..." 表示到现在为止一直无法做到。

articles.title: Meta heads to court in a landmark trial about kids and social media addiction
articles.summary: 四个州联合起诉 Meta，指控其社交平台被刻意设计成让儿童上瘾，并隐瞒对青少年心理健康的危害；案件或成科技问责里程碑。

sentences.en: Meta will head into federal court on Tuesday to fend off accusations that it designed its social media platforms to hook children.
sentences.zh: Meta 将于周二走进联邦法院，以反驳有关其社交平台被设计成诱使儿童上瘾的指控。

sentences.en: Four states are suing the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, alleging that the platforms were designed to hook kids.
sentences.zh: 四个州正在起诉 Facebook 和 Instagram 的母公司，指控这些平台被设计成让儿童上瘾。

sentences.en: The case is the latest in a wave of suits against social media companies, meant to hold them accountable for the way they design their products.
sentences.zh: 这起案件是针对社交媒体公司的一系列诉讼中的最新一桩，旨在让它们为其产品设计方式负责。

sentences.en: Legal experts compare it to landmark litigation against tobacco and opioid manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 法律专家将其比作针对烟草和阿片类制药商的标志性诉讼。

sentences.en: Four states are seeking up to $1.4 trillion in penalties and product changes under consumer protection laws.
sentences.zh: 四个州依据消费者权益保护法律，要求高达 1.4 万亿美元的罚款并要求其改变产品。

sentences.en: They say Meta also violated the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act by hoovering up data about children.
sentences.zh: 它们表示，Meta 还通过大肆收集儿童数据，违反了《儿童在线隐私保护法》。

sentences.en: “They’re putting the profits over the health of a generation of young people,” said New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州总检察长詹妮弗·达文波特说：“他们把利润置于一代年轻人的健康之上。”

sentences.en: One of the suit’s central arguments is that Meta designed features to capture young users’ attention and prolong their time on social media.
sentences.zh: 诉讼的一个核心论点是，Meta 设计了各种功能来抓住年轻用户的注意力，并延长他们在社交媒体上的时间。

sentences.en: The lawsuit alleges that Meta prioritized engagement over young users’ safety, creating products that disrupted their education and sleep.
sentences.zh: 诉讼指控 Meta 把用户参与度置于年轻用户的安全之上，制造出扰乱他们学业和睡眠的产品。

sentences.en: The lawsuit also alleges that Meta knew children under 13 were on Instagram and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 诉讼还指控 Meta 明知有 13 岁以下儿童在使用 Instagram 和 Facebook。

sentences.en: Social media companies have enjoyed some immunity from lawsuits because they are protected by the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体公司在一定程度上免于诉讼，因为它们受到第一修正案的保护。

vocab.zh: 形体障碍（body dysmorphia 体象障碍）

grammar: 动词不定式作目的："to fend off accusations" 中 to do 表目的。
that 引导同位语从句："accusations that it designed its platforms to hook children" 中 that 引导同位语从句，解释 accusations 的内容。
过去分词作后置定语："meant to hold them accountable" 中 meant 是过去分词作定语修饰 case。
现在分词作结果状语："creating products that disrupted their education and sleep" 现在分词短语表结果。
比较结构："compare it to landmark litigation" 用 compare A to B 结构。
介词短语："putting the profits over the health" 中 put A over B 表示“把 A 置于 B 之上”。
because 引导原因状语从句："because they are protected by the First Amendment" 为被动语态的原因从句。

articles.title: Missed shifts were costly to this McDonald’s. An app has fixed the problem
articles.summary: 一家麦当劳门店用一款员工支持 App 解决临时交通、托育等难题，帮没有车的年轻人按时上班，显著降低旷工带来的损失。

sentences.en: Unexpected absences can cost employers tens of thousands of dollars a month.
sentences.zh: 意外的缺勤每月可能让雇主损失数万美元。

sentences.en: The new high school graduate has been at this job for about a month.
sentences.zh: 这名刚高中毕业的新员工已经在这里工作大约一个月了。

sentences.en: It’s his first job ever — and so far, so good.
sentences.zh: 这是他有生以来的第一份工作——到目前为止，一切顺利。

sentences.en: Velasquez Ramos doesn’t have a car, and getting here by bus isn’t easy.
sentences.zh: 贝拉斯克斯·拉莫斯没有车，而坐公交车来这里并不容易。

sentences.en: But when no one’s been available, he’s turned to Escalate, a startup that began piloting its employee support app.
sentences.zh: 但当找不到人接送时，他转而求助于 Escalate——一家开始试点其员工支持 App 的初创公司。

sentences.en: Through the app, he’s been able to quickly get a voucher for an Uber, which gets him to work on time.
sentences.zh: 通过这个 App，他能够迅速拿到一张优步打车券，从而准时到达工作岗位。

sentences.en: Escalate is the brainchild of Sienna Daniel and Sean Segal, two veterans of the nonprofit world.
sentences.zh: Escalate 是西耶娜·丹尼尔和肖恩·西格尔的创意，两人都是非营利领域的老将。

sentences.en: For years, they focused on helping unemployed and underemployed people gain the skills needed to land jobs.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们专注于帮助失业和就业不足的人获得找到工作所需的技能。

sentences.en: But they saw that workers kept battling the same practical problems.
sentences.zh: 但他们发现，工人们一直在与同样的现实问题作斗争。

sentences.en: Cars broke down. Childcare fell through. Absences piled up, and people could not hang onto their jobs.
sentences.zh: 汽车抛锚，托育落空，缺勤越积越多，人们因而保不住工作。

sentences.en: “Opportunities might be there, but if they aren’t stabilized, there’s a problem,” says Daniel.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔说：“机会也许就在那里，但如果他们无法稳定下来，就会出现问题。”

grammar: 情态动词（can cost）："Unexpected absences can cost employers..." 中 can 表示“可能”，表客观可能性。
现在完成时（has been at）："has been at this job for about a month" 用现在完成时加 for 时间段，表示持续到现在的状态。
现在完成时（hasn’t been available）："when no one’s been available" 表示到现在为止一直未出现。
定语从句："a startup that began piloting its employee support app" 用 that 引导定语从句修饰 startup。
非限制性定语从句："a voucher for an Uber, which gets him to work on time" which 引导非限制性定语从句。
过去分词作后置定语："the skills needed to land jobs" 中 needed 为过去分词作后置定语修饰 skills。
并列短句："Cars broke down. Childcare fell through." 多个一般过去时短句并列，叙述一连串事件。

articles.title: Anthropic’s new invisible watermark marks content generated by AI chatbot Claude
articles.summary: Anthropic 为旗下 AI 助手 Claude 的新模型加入隐形水印，以符合欧盟《人工智能法案》；这项技术能在 AI 生成文本中留下肉眼不可见的标记，便于溯源。

sentences.en: Anthropic is adding an invisible watermark to new models of its AI assistant Claude.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 正在为其 AI 助手 Claude 的新模型加入隐形水印。

sentences.en: The change brings Claude into compliance with the European Union’s AI Act.
sentences.zh: 这一改动使 Claude 符合欧盟的《人工智能法案》。

sentences.en: It will be applied worldwide.
sentences.zh: 它将面向全球应用。

sentences.en: AI-generated text has been traditionally pretty hard to watermark, especially compared to images.
sentences.zh: 传统上，给 AI 生成的文本加水印相当困难，尤其是与图像相比。

sentences.en: Most AI-generated or AI-modified images already carry a type of watermark.
sentences.zh: 大多数 AI 生成或 AI 修改过的图像已经带有某种水印。

sentences.en: Previously, the best we’ve had for text is these probability checkers that make an assessment on how likely something is to be AI-generated.
sentences.zh: 此前，我们在文本方面最好的手段是这些概率检测工具，它们会评估某段文字有多大可能是 AI 生成的。

sentences.en: They explained over the weekend how it’s going to work.
sentences.zh: 他们在上周末解释了它将如何运作。

sentences.en: When AI writes a sentence, it’s not just spitting out words.
sentences.zh: 当 AI 写一句话时，它并不只是在吐出词语。

sentences.en: It’s making a tiny decision based on pattern prediction after every single word about what word comes next.
sentences.zh: 它在每一个词之后，都基于模式预测对“下一个词是什么”做一个微小的决定。

sentences.en: A lot of the time, there are several words that could work equally well.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，会有好几个词同样适用。

sentences.en: Whenever the AI makes a decision like this, Anthropic is going to be adding a mark.
sentences.zh: 每当 AI 做出这样的决定时，Anthropic 就会添加一个标记。

grammar: 现在进行时表将来安排："Anthropic is adding an invisible watermark" 用现在进行时表示已计划、即将发生的动作。
介词短语 into compliance with："brings Claude into compliance with the AI Act" 中 into compliance with 表示“符合……”。
现在完成时被动（has been...hard to watermark）："AI-generated text has been traditionally pretty hard to watermark" 现在完成时被动，描述长期状况。
定语从句："these probability checkers that make an assessment" 用 that 引导定语从句。
时间状语从句（When...）："When AI writes a sentence, it’s not just spitting out words" when 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在进行时。
过去分词短语作定语："based on pattern prediction" 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 decision。
there be 句型 + 定语从句："there are several words that could work equally well" 中 that 引导定语从句，could 表可能性。

articles.title: Why some companies are paying more than $1 million to get through the Panama Canal
articles.summary: 霍尔木兹海峡实际上关闭，加上水位下降，巴拿马运河通行费暴涨；部分公司单次过闸要付逾百万美元，成本最终会转嫁到消费者身上、推高通胀。

sentences.en: With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed, pressure on the Panama Canal has increased.
sentences.zh: 随着霍尔木兹海峡实际上被关闭，巴拿马运河承受的压力也随之增加。

sentences.en: Combined with lower water levels, transit prices through the canal are soaring.
sentences.zh: 再加上水位下降，运河的通行价格正在飙升。

sentences.en: According to new reporting from the Financial Times, some companies are having to cough up more than $1 million for each trip through the canal.
sentences.zh: 据《金融时报》的新报道，一些公司每次通过运河不得不掏出逾 100 万美元。

sentences.en: That’s more than 16 times what it cost a year ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一年前成本的 16 倍多。

sentences.en: One of the big tankers that carries liquefied petroleum gas reportedly paid 4.6 million just to go through on one of these auction slots.
sentences.zh: 据报道，一艘运输液化石油气的大型油轮仅为通过一个此类拍卖时段就支付了 460 万美元。

sentences.en: It’s really a staggering sum which they’re now having to pay to get through the canal.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一笔令人咋舌的金额，而他们现在不得不支付才能通过运河。

sentences.en: It’s going to be the shipping companies to start with.
sentences.zh: 起先是航运公司来承担这笔费用。

sentences.en: But ultimately, it feeds through the economy, and it means higher prices for consumers.
sentences.zh: 但最终，它会渗透进整个经济，意味着消费者要面对更高的价格。

sentences.en: That will push up inflation.
sentences.zh: 那将推高通货膨胀。

sentences.en: The shipping companies are already passing on these extra costs of the transit.
sentences.zh: 航运公司已经在转嫁这些额外的通行成本。

sentences.en: MSC shipping line just announced it’s going to introduce a new surcharge of $376 for a 45-foot container.
sentences.zh: 地中海航运公司刚刚宣布，将为 45 英尺的集装箱新增 376 美元的新附加费。

grammar: with 复合结构（With...closed）："With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed" 中 with + 宾语 + 形容词，作原因状语。
过去分词作原因状语："Combined with lower water levels" 过去分词短语作原因状语。
现在进行时（are soaring）："transit prices ... are soaring" 用进行时表正在发生的变化趋势。
动词短语（cough up）："are having to cough up more than $1 million" 中 cough up 为口语短语，意为“勉强付出（钱）”。
定语从句："One of the big tankers that carries liquefied petroleum gas" that 引导定语从句。
将来时（is going to / will）："It’s going to be the shipping companies" 与 "That will push up inflation" 表将来。
现在进行时表近期安排："MSC shipping line just announced it’s going to introduce a new surcharge" 间接引语中转述将来动作。

articles.title: A good – and bad – week for Italy’s art police and museum security
articles.summary: 意大利“艺术警察”一周内先找回帕尔马近千万美元被盗名画，又在西西里节庆夜痛失四位文艺复兴大师画作；文物保护的攻防战仍在继续。

sentences.en: On Friday, Italian police said they’d recovered three paintings stolen from a museum near the city of Parma.
sentences.zh: 周五，意大利警方表示，他们已找回三幅从帕尔马附近一家博物馆被盗的画作。

sentences.en: By Saturday night, thieves in Sicily had made off with four more masterpieces.
sentences.zh: 到周六夜里，西西里的窃贼又卷走了四幅杰作。

sentences.en: In late March, a gang used a tractor to batter down a fence before two masked burglars broke into the Magnani Rocca Foundation.
sentences.zh: 三月下旬，一个团伙用拖拉机撞倒围栏，随后两名蒙面窃贼闯入马尼亚尼·罗卡基金会。

sentences.en: The roughly $10 million haul included Cézanne’s Still Life with Cherries and Renoir’s Les Poissons.
sentences.zh: 这批约 1000 万美元的赃物包括塞尚的《樱桃静物》和雷诺阿的《鱼》。

sentences.en: This past Friday, officials said the paintings had been recovered during searches that prosecutors had ordered.
sentences.zh: 上周五，官员们表示，这些画作是在检察官下令进行的搜查中被找回的。

sentences.en: That investigative effort was led by the Italian police branch known as the carabinieri.
sentences.zh: 那次调查行动由意大利被称为“卡宾枪兵”的警察分支牵头。

sentences.en: While attention in the city may have been elsewhere, thieves got past the alarm system at Messina’s museum.
sentences.zh: 尽管全城的注意力可能在别处，窃贼还是绕过了墨西拿一家博物馆的警报系统。

sentences.en: In Saturday’s heist, thieves made off with three of the five surviving panels from an altarpiece by Antonello da Messina.
sentences.zh: 在周六的盗窃中，窃贼卷走了安东内洛·达·墨西拿一幅祭坛画现存五块嵌板中的三块。

sentences.en: The work originally had six panels, but one was destroyed along with the monastery that housed it in the 1908 Messina earthquake.
sentences.zh: 这幅作品原本有六块嵌板，但其中一块连同收藏它的修道院在 1908 年墨西拿地震中被毁。

sentences.en: Antonello’s work is highly prized in his home country.
sentences.zh: 安东内洛的作品在他的祖国备受珍视。

sentences.en: Authorities explained that nine people of Moldovan nationality have been placed under investigation.
sentences.zh: 当局解释说，九名摩尔多瓦籍人员已被立案调查。

grammar: 过去完成时（said they’d recovered）："police said they’d recovered" 主句过去时，从句用过去完成时表示“过去的过去”。
过去完成时（had made off）："thieves ... had made off with four more masterpieces" 表示在过去某时间前已发生的动作。
时间介词（By Saturday night）："By Saturday night" 与过去完成时连用，表示“到……为止”。
定语从句："the monastery that housed it" 中 that 引导定语从句。
让步状语从句（While...）："While attention ... may have been elsewhere" while 引导让步状语从句，表示“尽管”。
一般过去时被动（was destroyed）："one was destroyed along with the monastery" 被动语态叙述过去事件。
现在完成时被动（have been placed）："nine people ... have been placed under investigation" 现在完成时被动，强调至今状态。

articles.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
articles.summary: 在房价高企的华盛顿特区，一群年轻女性入住由修女管理的廉价社区之家；十年后房屋将关闭，她们收获的不仅是低租金，更是一份如同家人的情谊。

sentences.en: The house has given young women an affordable place to live while they studied or launched careers.
sentences.zh: 这所房子为年轻女性提供了一个可负担的居所，让她们在求学或开启职业生涯时有个落脚处。

sentences.en: By nightfall, it will close its doors for the last time.
sentences.zh: 到黄昏时分，它将最后一次关上大门。

sentences.en: “I’m 76 years old and running a house like this takes a lot of energy,” Roche said.
sentences.zh: “我 76 岁了，经营这样一所房子非常耗费精力，”罗氏修女说。

sentences.en: It’s one of several homes throughout the U.S. run by the Society of the Sacred Heart.
sentences.zh: 它是全美由“圣心会”管理的多所住所之一。

sentences.en: As a member of the international religious order, Roche has worked in Haiti and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
sentences.zh: 作为这个国际修会的成员，罗氏曾在海地和刚果民主共和国工作。

sentences.en: Anne Montgomery House is part of a broader housing trend emerging in expensive cities.
sentences.zh: 安妮·蒙哥马利之家是出现在高房价城市中的一股更广泛住房趋势的一部分。

sentences.en: Early-career professionals are opting to live in Catholic-run homes that offer below-market rent.
sentences.zh: 处于职业生涯早期的职场人士正选择住在由天主教会运营的、低于市场价的住所里。

sentences.en: But some residents find more than cheap housing.
sentences.zh: 但有些住户得到的不仅仅是一处便宜的房子。

sentences.en: At Anne Montgomery, a group of young women found a built-in community and support network.
sentences.zh: 在安妮·蒙哥马利之家，一群年轻女性找到了一个天然的社群和互助网络。

sentences.en: When Abigail Bulman arrived at the house, she expected little more than a roof over her head.
sentences.zh: 当阿比盖尔·布尔曼来到这所房子时，她只期待有个遮风挡雨的屋顶。

sentences.en: Instead, she found herself sharing homemade dinners that transformed a group of strangers into something close to a family.
sentences.zh: 结果，她发现自己和大家一起分享家常晚餐，这些晚餐把一群陌生人变成了近乎家人的存在。

grammar: 动词不定式作定语："an affordable place to live" 中 to live 修饰 place。
一般将来时（will close）："it will close its doors for the last time" 用一般将来时叙述即将发生的事。
动名词作主语："running a house like this takes a lot of energy" 动名词短语 running... 作主语，谓语用单数 takes。
过去分词作后置定语："homes ... run by the Society of the Sacred Heart" 过去分词短语修饰 homes。
现在完成时（has worked）："Roche has worked in Haiti and..." 表示过去到现在的工作经历。
现在进行时（are opting）："professionals are opting to live..." 用进行时表示当前正在形成的趋势。
定语从句："homes that offer below-market rent" 与 "homemade dinners that transformed..." 用 that 引导定语从句。
